name: Kiva | 200mg Chocolate | Churro
description:
10mg THC per serving | 200mg THC total in 20 servings

DETAILS: Dusted in cinnamon sugar, this sweetly satisfying 200mg THC milk chocolate bar tastes like a golden, fried churro dipped in delicious hot chocolate.

• Made using Ghiradelli's chocolate

• Infused with Cold Water Hash

• Solventless processing

INGREDIENTS: Milk Chocolate (Sugar, Cocoa Butter, Milk, Unsweetened Chocolate, Sunflower Lecithin, Vanilla), Cane Sugar, Saigon Cinnamon, Cannabis Extract, Natural Flavors
